## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?

Confirmations: Financials and Industrials are both negative (sector 1W returns -2.64% / -3.08%), while defensives/healthcare names (JNJ (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +4.59%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +13.92%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +16.36%) ABOVE TREND) are holding up; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

Healthcare strong: MRK (1W: +9.92% | 1M: +16.88%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +20.53%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.08% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples: EL (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +16.36%) ABOVE TREND, MDLZ (1W: +x% | 1M: +x%) ABOVE TREND (sector-level outperformance noted).

3. Which sectors are lagging?

Industrials lag: CAT (1W: -4.59% | 1M: -8.31%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -6.61% | 1M: +3.09%) CORRECTION. Financials soft: JPM (1W: -3.18% | 1M: +0.96%) CORRECTION, overall sector 1W -2.64%.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

Strongest 1W moves: NEM (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +33.31%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +16.36%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.92% | 1M: +16.88%) ABOVE TREND; note major divergence in Mega-Cap Tech where MSFT (1W: -2.98% | 1M: +23.50%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -3.75% | 1M: +2.26%) CORRECTION and AMZN (1W: -1.89% | 1M: +6.23%) CORRECTION — tactical risk.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology in weakness with concentrated large-cap pressure: META (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -12.87% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.75% | 1M: +2.26%) CORRECTION; sector 1W -4.01% and 24 names — internal rotation and de-risking.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials soft on the week: JPM (1W: -3.18% | 1M: +0.96%) CORRECTION, V (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +7.87%) ABOVE TREND — mixed internals with overall sector 1W -2.64% (20 stocks), monitor credit/capital flow signals.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare resilient: MRK (1W: +9.92% | 1M: +16.88%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +20.53%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +4.59%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W +2.06% and showing defensive characteristics in the RISK-OFF backdrop.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor energy, materials and select healthcare exposure given current RISK-OFF where cyclicals in commodity/defensive pockets show strength; reduce exposure to large-cap tech names showing multi-timeframe deterioration (META (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -12.87% | 1M: -8.26%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth/Momentum.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XOM (1W: +5.43% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND — watch continuation above recent resistance for further leadership; NVDA (1W: -3.75% | 1M: +2.26%) CORRECTION — watch 1W breakdown for deeper pullback; WMT (1W: -10.27% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND — monitor earnings/comp data for confirmation of sales slowdown.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value/Cyclical style. COP (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.92% | 1M: +16.88%) ABOVE TREND and NEM (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +33.31%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap Tech divergence (MSFT (1W: -2.98% | 1M: +23.50%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -3.75% | 1M: +2.26%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND) plus headline-driven retail weakness at WMT (1W: -10.27% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND.
